metas.name: 1. Beef
metas.description: The Professor attempts to create lab-grown meat so Fry can compete in the world hotdog-eating championship.

metas.name: 2. Catfish Hunter
metas.description: Bender travels to Mississippi in search of a sexy scammer who ripped off his grandmother.

metas.name: 3. Our Flag Means Medical Coverage
metas.description: Bender and Fry are hired to deliver a priceless cargo, but they are attacked and pillaged by vicious space pirates.

metas.name: 4. Lords of the Ring
metas.description: The Planet Express ship crash-lands on a mysterious world inhabited by intelligent rats.

metas.name: 5. The Charm Offensive
metas.description: Amy's favorite pop star commands her massive army of fans using musical brain programming.

metas.name: 6. Late Bloomers
metas.description: Hermes takes desperate measures to save his dying father, as Zoidberg reunites with an old flame.

metas.name: 7. Lord Nibbler in the Nothingverse
metas.description: Nibbler says goodbye after being chosen for a one-way mission to observe a dying universe.

metas.name: 8. Oceans Three
metas.description: The Planet Express crew sets sail on an epic ocean adventure.

metas.name: 9. A New New York Yankee in King Elfo's Court
metas.description: A time-machine failure sends Fry sideways in time to a strangely familiar medieval land.

metas.name: 10. Final Ending: The Last Conclusion
metas.description: When Fry sneaks into a PG-13 movie as a kid, it results in shocking consequences a thousand years in the future.
